About Box & Motion

We want more out of our box scores.

A box score tells you who scored. It doesn’t tell you how the game was won: the run that flipped it, the matchup a coach kept going back to, the play drawn up out of a timeout.

Who we are

Fans with a day job in data

Our team has a background in analytics and AI enablement. We love basketball, and we don’t have time to watch every game anymore. We still want to know what actually happened.

What we make

The story of the game, in motion

Every game, told through the numbers and simple X’s and O’s: where it was won, who carried it, and the play that decided it, drawn so you can see it in about a minute.

How we make it.

Scores and records come from league stats, and every number in a recap is checked against the box score or a named game story. The plays are original illustrations drawn from written accounts, not traced from footage and not to scale. We use AI tools to help draw and publish it all, and we skip anything we can’t verify rather than guess.

Box & Motion is unofficial fan coverage and is not affiliated with the NBA or any team. Team names are used to identify teams; we don’t use team logos. Official video plays from the league’s own uploads; we never re-upload it.
